parameters.name: access_key_id
parameters.description: AWS access key ID for authentication

parameters.name: secret_access_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key for authentication

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region where the S3 bucket is located (e.g., us-east-1)

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: Temporary session token for AWS STS credentials

parameters.name: encryption_key
parameters.description: Base64-encoded 256-bit AES key for client-side encryption

parameters.name: account_key
parameters.description: Azure Storage account key for authentication

parameters.name: connection_string
parameters.description: Full Azure Storage connection string (alternative to account_name + account_key)

parameters.name: encryption_scope
parameters.description: Azure encryption scope for customer-managed keys

parameters.name: service_account_key
parameters.description: JSON service account key for authentication

parameters.name: kms_key_name
parameters.description: Cloud KMS key resource name for encryption

parameters.name: connection_string
parameters.description: Database connection string (supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server)

parameters.name: ssl_key
parameters.description: SSL private key for encrypted connections
